Empty columns test: `export_csv([{"a":1}], [])` should produce `"\r\n\r\n"` — header line is empty, plus one record line (empty), each ending CRLF. And `([], [])` → `"\r\n"`.

Also note: header quoting — if column names contain commas/quotes, should we quote them? RFC 4180 minimal quoting suggests yes. I'll quote header cells too.

What about invalid column types — reject with ValueError even when empty rows? Test `export_csv([], [1, "a"])` raises. So validate columns regardless.

Note bool is subclass of int but also... we check isinstance(str) so bool rejected. Fine.
